papers.title: Intravenous drug abuse is a risk factor in the failure of two‐stage treatment for infected total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: Reinfection after two-stage revision hip arthroplasty (RHA) is still a complex issue. Only few studies revealed the factors affecting the success rate in the treatment of periprosthetic hip infection (PHI), especially risk factors. A retrospective study was conducted using records of 30 patients underwent two-stage RHA for infected total hip arthroplasty (THA). Treatment was defined as successful if a patient did not need any reoperation or invasive procedure such as image-guided drainage during the two years after reimplantation. Treatment was defined as failure if any surgery or invasive procedure or long-term antibiotic suppression was considered necessary to control infection. Four patients had infection recurrence defined as failed and three of them had intravenous drug abuse. Twenty-six patients had no infection recurrence at the end of follow-up and one of them had intravenous drug abuse but quitting after surgery. We suggest that once adequate cleaning up achieved, risk of reinfection may be little even in immunocompromised patients with RHA because of relative less old age than those with revisional total knee arthroplasty. Patients of the reinfection group were younger and non-obese with adequate nutritional status. We may consider intravenous drug abuse could take a great toll on health and lead to reinfection. Finally, we suggest performing the gold-standard two-stage reimplantation technique to manage cases with infection, educating drug abusers regarding the risk of surgical failure, and implementing a quitting program at least 1 year before the index surgery.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究静脉注射毒品对感染全髋关节置换术后二期翻修失败的影响，未涉及任何生物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any mechanical analysis; it is purely clinical and epidemiological with no implant modeling or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 识别全髋关节置换术后感染二期翻修失败的风险因素。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析30例感染全髋关节置换术二期翻修患者的临床记录，比较复发性感染组与无感染组特征。
summary_zh.result: 4例复发性感染中3例有静脉注射毒品史，占该组75%，而无感染组仅1例。
summary_zh.validation: 基于2年随访的回顾性单中心数据分析。

summary_en.motivation: To identify risk factors for failure of two-stage revision hip arthroplasty for periprosthetic joint infection, particularly intravenous drug abuse.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 30 patients undergoing two-stage revision for infected THA; treatment failure defined as need for reoperation or long-term antibiotics within 2 years.
summary_en.result: Intravenous drug abuse was significantly associated with reinfection (3 of 4 failure cases vs. 1 of 26 success cases).
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical follow-up at a single institution.
